Since that offer fell through, I'll focus on building houses on light blues instead. With $845 on hand and houses at $50 each, putting 3 on each property would cost $450, leaving $395 - but maybe 2 each at $300 is safer, leaving $545 while still getting good ROI on Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut.

Actually, 3 houses still seems like the sweet spot since I can mortgage railroads for $100 each, Atlantic and Ventnor for $130, and Pacific for $150 if I need cash back, plus houses sell back for half value. I'll commit to 3 on each.
